records.title: Build project digital twins
originalAcceptance: Predictions are calibrated against real staging outcomes and documented uncertainty.
Twin changes cannot affect production or expose sensitive data.
records.currentClaim: Current twin is an illustrative queueing/capacity scenario, not a measured software/infrastructure replica.
records.candidateNeed: actual adapter/source discovery and qualified behavior tests

records.title: Add cost and revenue impact models
originalAcceptance: Scenarios trace to real input data and explicitly distinguish forecasts from facts.
Revenue and cost access is permission-controlled.
records.currentClaim: No real billing, unit economics or revenue model is connected.
records.candidateNeed: actual adapter/source discovery and qualified behavior tests

records.title: Replace future-state templates with evaluated plans
originalAcceptance: Every horizon has project-specific evidence and testable milestones.
Predictions remain hypotheses with evaluations, not guaranteed futures.
records.currentClaim: V2/V3/V5/V10 are disclosed planning templates informed by snapshot gaps.
records.candidateNeed: actual adapter/source discovery and qualified behavior tests

records.title: Connect product and business intelligence
originalAcceptance: Recommendations reference real evidence and measurable business objectives.
Sensitive business/customer data has scoped access and retention.
records.currentClaim: No real customer, product, market, revenue or competitor evidence is ingested.
records.candidateNeed: actual adapter/source discovery and qualified behavior tests

records.title: Build innovation discovery and validation
originalAcceptance: Proposals include sources, competing solutions, validation plans and experimental results.
The system does not claim that nobody has built something without evidence.
records.currentClaim: Innovation Discovery is a catalog domain; no invention pipeline or novelty evaluation exists.
records.candidateNeed: actual adapter/source discovery and qualified behavior tests

records.title: Complete executive intelligence scores
originalAcceptance: All 14 dimensions have documented methodology and evidence or an explicit unassessed state.
A score never implies a certification or unsupported measurement.
records.currentClaim: Seven heuristic scores exist; no complete executive scorecard or measured business readiness exists.
records.candidateNeed: actual adapter/source discovery and qualified behavior tests

records.title: Complete accessibility and responsive verification
originalAcceptance: Representative viewport and assistive-technology journeys pass with recorded findings.
All critical actions work without a mouse.
records.currentClaim: Responsive styles and component primitives exist; no measured accessibility audit is complete.
records.candidateNeed: actual adapter/source discovery and qualified behavior tests

records.title: Implement scoped compliance and legal auditing
originalAcceptance: Reports distinguish measured controls, missing evidence and legal interpretation.
No unsupported certification or legal conclusion is issued.
records.currentClaim: Compliance and Legal Auditing are domain definitions; there are no evidence collectors or jurisdiction-specific controls.
records.candidateNeed: actual adapter/source discovery and qualified behavior tests

records.title: Prepare release documentation and operating evidence
originalAcceptance: A new authorized operator can set up, verify, recover and upgrade the platform using the docs.
Release notes accurately distinguish engineering work, activation and verification.
records.currentClaim: README, architecture status and evidence files exist, but full operating/developer documentation is incomplete.
records.candidateNeed: actual adapter/source discovery and qualified behavior tests

records.title: Resolve the unused Vercel experiment

Cleanup outcome is verified; absence of a supported delete operation is documented.
records.currentClaim: An empty optional worker project was created; sandbox creation returned 403 and no running worker/deployment was established.
records.candidateNeed: actual adapter/source discovery and qualified behavior tests
